recent_en: Thriven Global Berhad has no major announcements or news recently. The latest quarterly results show a sharp decline in revenue QoQ and a wider net loss.
risks_en: Latest quarterly revenue fell 74.0% QoQ and net loss widened 198.2% QoQ.
Latest quarterly net margin was -95.9%, down from 25.4% in the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 3,979,000, down 74.0% QoQ and 40.3% YoY; net loss was MYR 3,816,000, with the loss widening 198.2% QoQ and a net margin of -95.9%.
